verdict.rationale: Insomnia's Git Sync connects projects directly to any third-party Git repository without going through the cloud. Project data stays in your repo, and an in-app merge view resolves conflicts. Insomnia YAML (v5) as a native format implies the stored data is plain text. Missing for 10: explicit docs stating that Git Sync writes collections as human-readable plain-text files in the repo (only implied by the YAML v5 format), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the git-versioned file workflow.
